steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: Here's the files on Chernobog, chief. They're on your desk.

steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: Hope you can find the info you wanted somewhere in those dusty papers.

steps.name: Editor
steps.text: Thanks for sorting them out, Zhenya.
The assistant closes the door as he leaves, as usual. It scrapes against the uneven flooring, letting out a shrieking sound.
The editor sits up straight, lights a cigarette, and pushes through the discomfort as he flips through the stack of old newspapers.

steps.name: Editor
steps.text: 'The Third Army's Dereliction of Duty in the Chernobog Incident...'

steps.name: Editor
steps.text: Tch... Same old, same old. 'Chernobog Closes Mine—a Heavy Blow to Ursus's Originium Industry'.

steps.name: Editor
steps.text: ...'Novochernobog—The Infected Lives a Blessed Life Under His Majesty's Glory'.

steps.name: Editor
steps.text: Utter drivel.

steps.name: Editor
steps.text: No, this isn't what I want... These trashy tabloids are barely scratching the surface.

steps.name: Editor
steps.text: ...None of these reports are anywhere close to the truth.
The editor pushes up his glasses and flicks away some stray cigarette ash, but accidentally sends sparks flying onto the paper.
He rushes to extinguish the sudden fire, but the newspaper already bears a freshly burnt hole.
Through the hole the editor sees an ensemble of letters—'Reunion'.
A name he has never heard of before.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: In the last few days, a stream of Infected have been showing up wanting to join Reunion.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I told them we'll be leaving Londinium in one month's time, heading for the Duke of Gododdin's territory.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Are they willing to follow us there?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They neither agreed nor refused. They couldn't come up with an answer.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...I'll prepare for bringing them along. They have nowhere else to go.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Gododdin. I hear the Duke's issued more than a few decrees benefiting the Infected, so it's worth checking out.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Decrees and reality are not the same thing.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Obviously. Which is why we need to see for ourselves.
From a corner comes a rustling sound as Ch'en turns a newspaper page.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Nothing to say even after listening in for so long, Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Everything you've talked about is internal business.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: As an outsider, I have no right to comment. I've been focusing on the news anyway.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You weren't this quiet with many of the others in private.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We need your thoughts, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: When I let you tag along with us, it wasn't just to show you how different we are from the other organizations.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Don't go getting the idea that you'd have to take responsibility for either of us.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Given our current situation, anyone's input is welcome, as long as we can help these people out. So speak your mind.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're planning to take in people with nowhere else to go?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: They'll bring new vitality to our group.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Or new conflicts.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This group you've gathered under the banner of what you're calling 'Reunion' is as rag-tag as they come.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Is this what you promised me when you left?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not to mention her.
Ch'en looks toward the indifferent Talulah.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're bound to attract more eyes in future.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So if you ask me, I suggest staying in Londinium for a while, and restructuring yourselves—

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You mean letting someone more suitable handle it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I won't deny that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just look at the people you have here. Criminals, Infected, deserters... Do you have a clue where you're taking them?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We're not going to stay here forever, at the very least.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: What is it? What's the hurry?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Nine, Red just came back with some urgent news. Ugh—
He shoots a glance at Ch'en.
Ever since the stranger called Ch'en showed up, his companions have been behaving strangely.
She rarely leaves Talulah and Nine alone, but has never once commented on Reunion's actions either.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Go on. She's one of us.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Troops from the ducal alliance are approaching the factory. Should we get them to leave?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Ducal troops? They can't be coming for us, but... I'll head there myself and see what's going on.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Talulah... keep everyone else hidden.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So, you agree with Nine's methods?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Not exactly. But this group is nothing like the original group I traveled with on the tundra.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Unfortunately, oppressed peoples are treated the same way no matter where they are.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No one cares where we go, Hui-chieh, only where we decide to stop. And then they'll figure out how to drive us away.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: 'Reunion'. It's a mistake I've made myself...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Nine has no intention of wiping my slate clean, but if she needs me to come up with a new meaning—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I have no right to refuse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And her conscience is crystal clear.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Nine... and myself, we know very well what we're doing.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But you, Hui-chieh. You chased me—or rather, Reunion—all the way here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Why are you still delaying what you decided long ago?
Talulah leaves. Ch'en doesn't catch up with her.

steps.name: Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Keep moving, you beasts. Don't stop!

steps.name: Sarkaz Civilian
steps.text: Tch... Bloody bastards!

steps.name: Angry Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Get up! Now!

steps.name: Angry Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Look at these disgusting sick freaks. Wish I could just get rid of them here and now.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: The Exemplars' territory is just ahead. Are you considering dumping our rubbish right on their doorstep?

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: I say we stay out of trouble. They've already set up garbage disposal stations, so no littering.

steps.name: Sarkaz Civilian
steps.text: Garbage disposal...?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I won't ask when or where you got your orders, soldier.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: But this is no place for an execution.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Ah, the Infected hiding in the factory.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: You should be thankful that we're busy catching these devils instead of—
The air grows warm. Nine casts a quick glance toward a corner shrouded in darkness.
Within it, a fire ignites, then slowly dims.

steps.name: Angry Alliance Soldier
steps.text: You... Did you just feel a tingling on your skin, like—

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Like I got burned by fire.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: ...Itching for a fight, huh?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: This factory area is under the Exemplars' protection.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So why don't you go ask your superiors if they'd mind an idiotic subordinate stirring up conflict here and smashing this hard-won peace to pieces?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I think you'll know how to speak to us after that.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: But suppose our allies, our 'friends', were to show inappropriate sympathy and compassion towards our common enemy—

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: I imagine my superiors would be humming a different tune.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Move, Infected.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...They don't sound like they came from Kazdel.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Devils are freakishly good at disguises.

steps.name: Cold Alliance Soldier
steps.text: There's no way we're letting a devil merc slide past us.

steps.name: Angry Alliance Soldier
steps.text: Get moving, you damned devils!

steps.name: Sarkaz Civilian
steps.text: Ugh...
The squad escorting the Sarkaz slowly trudge through the long street, though both captors and captives look exhausted and numb.
Nine watches as they leave, and spots a few teenagers stumbling at the end of the downcast parade of prisoners.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Bastards...

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: Here's the place, sir. The blaze lasted for three days and left basically nothing behind.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: Did the fire spread anywhere other than the Patrol Unit's outpost?

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: No... but many miners seized the chance to escape. Everyone was so scared... Didn't know when the Patrol Unit would arrive...

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: But seems like you got here first. You said you're a reporter? But who's to say for sure?

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: ...Let's not get into that. So, if the management here has always been hard on everyone, how did the miners carry out the arson?

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: The miners?

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: No, no. The village had an old noble from the city, good heart, that man... but a bit too kindhearted, if you ask me.

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: Couldn't stand what was happening in the mines, always talking about rescuing the miners. We thought it was all talk, but in the end...

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: He really went and did it.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: Oh? Then where is he now?

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: Must've died in the blaze with the Patrol Unit.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: Hah. A noble who bravely sacrificed his life to help the suffering Infected miners.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: That would make a pretty good headline.
The reporter gazes at the scorched land. Nearby buildings have been reduced to rubble, and in place of the once lush forest stands unsightly tree stumps.
Suddenly, a scorch mark draws his attention. It looks unusual, almost aesthetically pleasing.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: Do you... know who left this mark here?

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: That's just from the fire.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: I'm not buying that. It looks like a 'symbol' to me.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: So—who left it here?

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: Uh... no clue. It was just here after the fire.

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: So you're saying it was a deliberate act, an attempt to send out a signal: 'Salvation'.

steps.name: Local Villager
steps.text: A-Am I?

steps.name: News Reporter
steps.text: (Laughs) Didn't you just explain the real history behind it for me?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No need to rush. Get in line, everyone will get some.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: How much longer do we have to stay here, Miss Ch'en?

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: When will the next squad leave the city...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't worry. You're safe here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've reached out through many different channels to get everyone out of here.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: I-I heard the Sarkaz-hunting soldiers have found this place.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: If they find out you're sheltering us...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Sheltering? Why speak as if you're fugitives on the run?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're citizens of Londinium, victims of this war.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: We were already unwelcome long before the Sarkaz troops entered the city.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: Believe me, it's more than just soldiers on that team.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: Being a Sarkaz is already a crime, the worst one you can commit. Doesn't matter if you took part in the war or not.

spans.text: Being a Sarkaz is already a
, the worst one you can commit. Doesn't matter if you took part in the war or not.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: Anyways... Thanks for taking us in.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: I ironed it out with the others. We'll wait three days for a chance to leave the city. If we don't get one, we'll go by ourselves.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It's not the best time to leave. The soldiers have been even more active recently.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: All the more reason to get out as soon as we can. Every day we put it off will only worsen the situation.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...If you insist, we'll help you out.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: Appreciate the generosity. I suggest you guys do the same.

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: Who do you think they'll target next, once the city's out of Sarkaz?

steps.name: Weary Sarkaz
steps.text: Most of you are Infected. You should know how their nobles treat you guys.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Today's paper, sir.

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: Hmm... I can't be bothered to read it, Alyosha. Anything noteworthy?

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: New tax policies, some literary works, a few scandals, and...

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Revolts. All over the country.

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: Finally, some real reporting. I thought those Deity Grypherburg reporters only knew how to run tabloids.

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: 'Infected have been striking at factories and outposts across the country. Some regions are experiencing a surge of uprisings, as Infected have brazenly attacked outposts and government agencies, causing serious losses...'

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: 'It is said that they are inspired by an Infected organization known as Reunion...'

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: Oh, look, they even left some symbols...

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: ...Do you wish to end your convalescence now?

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: Of course not. Do you even realize how hard it is for me to get a vacation?

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: But your colleagues from the propaganda department have visited you many times already.

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: Oh, my dear Alyoshenka, our dear nation has been suffering from a chronic disease for quite some time, and there are many who wish to heal her.

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: But to do so, these rotten old wounds must first see the light of day.

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: I've had enough of my colleagues patching them up, over and over.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: How should I reply then?

steps.name: Carefree Noble
steps.text: Tell them any discussion must wait until my vacation is over.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Did they ransack the streets again for another batch of prisoners? Here's your soup, Talulah.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Too bland? Well—I had to ransack our stash to get the last of the salt.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's fine. Good, even.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Heh. 'Ransack'? That's a good word.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Only a week ago they wouldn't have come here, let alone taken any children among the prisoners.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But we just saw both happen.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: They've been dead set on wiping out any trace of the Sarkaz for the past two weeks.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: At first, it was just Sarkaz soldiers who couldn't evacuate in time. Next, it was any Sarkaz civilian who had any dealings with the army. Now? Even Londinium-born Sarkaz aren't being spared.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I thought you'd make a move, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...That would only complicate things. We're in Victoria, so I have to act more cautiously.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: That'll only cost us more time.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: A few days ago I saw a group of kids harassing a poor woman... all she did was to marry a Sarkaz and raise their children together.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: This is how they treated the Infected before the war, and now it's the Sarkaz's turn. Eventually, every Londinium citizen will face this.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Time is what these mistreated people lack most.
Nine pauses to glance at Talulah right beside her.
However, she seems unusually calm, as if the sudden temperature increase earlier was just a hallucination.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I thought you'd make a move on the Victorians earlier.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It was only a warning. It'd only bring us more trouble if we pestered them any further. Hui-chieh has a point—We should keep a low profile until we're forced to show ourselves.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Attacking ducal alliance troops on the factory streets certainly won't do anything to improve the lives of the workers here.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So you weren't angry.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What you're experiencing, I have too, long ago. But at least Sarkaz blood isn't contagious like Oripathy.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've long since learned to control my rage. At the very least, I won't waste it on clueless underlings like the soldiers from before.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: This war has turned the oppressed into oppressors. It's not their fault.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Then who should the innocent Sarkaz vent their anger on?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Remember that Sarkaz merchant with the motorbike who helped us get supplies...? The Infected killed him out of fear.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Now, that fear is spreading unchecked as the Sarkaz are gradually retreating.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Infected, soldiers, nobles... heh, even civilians who've never seen war. Everyone thinks they're in the right.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So you're correct, Talulah. Sarkaz blood isn't contagious like Oripathy... but hatred and fear are.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You've decided then?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: To save the Sarkaz? I see no need to hesitate. They're no different from us.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I'm just not sure how to minimize the fallout, so I need your help.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Keep the people at camp safe, as well as the workers.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...If you need my flames to burn for them, I won't hesitate.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Red, let the workers know our plan. Those willing to join us can stay; anyone too afraid to escape, bring them to the Exemplars' camp.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Ch'en.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You can try to stop us, or you can leave and pretend nothing happened.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Saving those Sarkaz means you'll have to change everything you've planned.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And if you go with them, none of the Dukes will let you stay long in their domain, Nine.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: They won't let us stay long anyway, even without those people.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We're Infected, Ch'en. Maybe your time at Rhodes Island has made you forget how we're actually treated.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then where will you go next?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So you agree with our plan?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Even prisoners shouldn't be executed so hastily. They don't even have an official order.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Hui-chieh, the issue isn't where Nine and the others want to go, but where they're needed.

spans.text: Hui-chieh, the issue isn't where Nine and the others
to go, but where they're needed.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We'll find a place that truly needs us, Ch'en.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Not just the Infected... Anyone enslaved or deprived of their right to a fair chance at survival.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: A place with no discrimination or oppression.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...You know as well as the rest of us that that'll be difficult, if not impossible, Nine.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Of course. But this is the path a man we all knew left us before he died.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Guard...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Someone has to see it through, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: This new Reunion makes their own medicine and strives to help anyone in need, without asking for anything tangible in return.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Change is happening, but it's too fragile.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They need something to believe in, an objective. That's the only way they can push forward.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I don't completely agree with Nine's way of doing things, but I see no reason to refuse to cooperate either.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: She's always admired the 'fairness' you seek, Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: So why not take a look at what she seeks?

spans.text: So why not take a look at what

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: On the tundra ignored by the Emperor's edict, rebel activity has intensified, with thousands of Infected banding together to break their shackles and regain their freedom.

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: We've achieved what used to be unthinkable.

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: Ever since that first fire ignited by that anonymous noble, many of us have been communicating in hushed tones: Is there someone leading us? To be honest, I'm not too sure myself.

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: What I do know is that our call to rise up has not been silenced, and is even now trying to escape from the tundra and its army of trees blocking the way.

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: Our proof is that unique symbol everyone's curious about, the symbol scorched by flame.
The hoarse voice on the radio smashes the countryside's peace apart.
People open their doors or climb onto their windowsills, listening quietly.
The broadcast excites them, their palms feeling hot even though they live in a place with temperatures far below zero.
Then, they light up torches in the center of the village. The light illuminates their eyes, and warms the bodies underneath their thin layers of clothing.
Soon, nearby villages spot the firelight and start bonfires one after the other.
On the dark tundra, countless fires light up the night sky.

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: We gather on this inhospitable tundra, following in their footsteps to take root here.

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: Everyone has heard of the group that disappeared into Chernobog to fight for the Infected: 'Reunion'.

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: Have they heard our call?

steps.name: Anonymous Radio
steps.text: Have they finally returned—

steps.name: Executioner Soldier
steps.text: Alrighty, you dregs! Turn around!

steps.name: Frightened Youth
steps.text: Sir... please... spare my life, please...

steps.name: Frightened Youth
steps.text: I was born here!

steps.name: Frightened Youth
steps.text: I-I'm different from the rest, sir, please!

steps.name: Executioner Soldier
steps.text: I said, shut it!

steps.name: Frightened Youth
steps.text: S-Sir, please...

steps.name: Sarkaz Civilian
steps.text: Kid, he doesn't give a damn who you are. He just wants to kill every Sarkaz he sees.

steps.name: Executioner Soldier
steps.text: Shut up!
The boy suddenly smells a strange scent. It makes him recall his mother's perfume as she hugged him.
Countless flowers bloom on the bloodstained floors, and the scent grows stronger.
The executioner suddenly coughs violently until he throws up a cluster of bloody flower buds.

steps.name: Executioner Soldier
steps.text: Ugh... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Frightened Youth
steps.text: Y-You...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Get them out of here. Our people will know what to do.

steps.name: Executioner Soldier
steps.text: You lot... don't... *cough*...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nine! Stop your Originium Arts!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You already saved the Sarkaz! Killing them... is a step too far.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Couldn't you have just kept silent as usual, Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop making more enemies everywhere you go, unless you want the Dukes chasing after Reunion once you leave the city.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Talulah can make sure that it looks like an accidental blaze.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No. They'll only put the blame on the Sarkaz, calling it an act of revenge.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And then what? Who will the Dukes turn their gaze to? More innocent Sarkaz.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Or, say, an Infected group wandering around Victoria with who-knows-how-many Sarkaz in tow.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Letting them go will only make things worse.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Tell me, Ch'en. When we finally come face to face with the ducal alliance with no chance at escape, how will you keep the Infected and innocent Sarkaz there safe?

steps.name: Executioner Soldier
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Enough! There're still other ways!
The tip of Ch'en's sword touches Nine's throat.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I've imagined this happening countless times.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: In fact, I'm shocked it didn't happen sooner.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I went to school with many of their superior officers. I can talk to them.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: As what? As a former senior inspector of the L.G.D.? As Operator Ch'en of Rhodes Island? Or, what... an old classmate, reminiscing about the good old days?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I can guarantee these Sarkaz will be safe, at least.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Of course, I trust you'll keep that promise.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: But you're missing my point, Ch'en.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: There are limits to one person's power. Even you can't help the people you can't see.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I know your capabilities all too well, and that's exactly why I'm even more sure that your momentary kindness won't change a thing. It can't.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: What I need is people willing to follow us, to see with their own eyes what we have to do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Spare me the sophistry, Nine.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm only looking at the facts.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: 'Sophistry', huh?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Maybe we're all seeking 'fairness', but our interpretations of it are different.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...This is why I've long since given up hope of you coming to understand me and the future I'm looking forward to.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You can most certainly try to arrest me, Officer Ch'en.
Chi Xiao stays in place, and Nine's gaze remains on Ch'en.
A flaming sword shakes Chi Xiao away.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: This isn't the place to wax nostalgic about your old days on the force.
Talulah stabs her longsword into the ground, separating the all-tensed-up two.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I didn't call for your help, Talulah. Don't act like you know everything better.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Nine, there is nothing wrong with Hui-chieh's idea.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The Dukes would be overjoyed at someone volunteering to remove every last Sarkaz from Londinium, and they might not make any moves on us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But more importantly, there are still eyes on the both of you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They only care about one thing: where should they go now?
The rescued Sarkaz and the Reunion members following Nine are both terrified. They have no idea what to do next.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Many of them can't understand exactly what it is you want, Nine. They just want to live.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They need time. It might take a while to show them the future you see.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Of course I know that.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I have the patience to wait for my 'sophistry' to bloom into a concrete plan of action.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And will you achieve that with even more sacrifices? How do you decide who?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ENOUGH!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not here to determine which of you is right or wrong. It's not my place to.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But for now, just take them away from here. Take everyone who's willing to leave the city with us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Hui-chieh might manage to prevent the Victorians from harassing us in the short term, but we'll still have to prepare for the worst.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Are you giving me an order, Talulah?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No, I'm offering my opinion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But where can you go?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your identities are too conspicuous.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Is this where you say we should go to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yes. I have to see the both of you judged.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But not right now. Many Infected are still relying on you, and I can't just leave them in the dust.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Hah... Classic Officer Ch'en.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Want my opinion?
Whenever Talulah proactively offers her thoughts to Nine, it often leaves the Phidia with even more doubts towards her.
But Talulah has never fallen behind.
She always walks silently in the center of their group, so inconspicuous that people forget she exists.
Reunion's leader, Kashchey's adopted daughter, and the manipulative mastermind behind the Chernobog disaster.
Talulah, regarded as a hero by Infected who do not know the truth.
Her sword begins to burn, and its flames spread across the floor. They jump and fall, outlining a symbol.
The firelight reflects in the trio's eyes, but their faces still bear some gloom—the mark once represented a dark past.
Within it hides all sorts of crimes and injustices, certain to sting if revealed for all to see.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Ursus.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We can go back to Ursus.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...That's a terrible idea.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: What, thinking about your unfinished business over there?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No, I want to right my wrongs.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've received news from Ursus. The Infected are breaking their shackles and congregating on the tundra again.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They claim to be answering the call of Reunion, and have decided to stand up and fight for the rights and freedoms the Infected and other oppressed deserve.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: They were inspired by a lie, but their determination to fight back is certainly real.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So they gave you the courage to recall the good old days?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...It's not only Infected over there. There are students, exiled officers and soldiers, guilt-ridden nobles...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's exactly the strength you need.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Strength that ignores the differences in race or identity and crushes the fear of disease, united by a common goal.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Besides, it'll take time to leave with this many people... and I think that should be long enough for you to explain Guard's precious dream to those still willing to follow you.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...You don't want to restore Reunion's reputation?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No. I never expected it to hold such a large influence even today.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Even if the Ursus Empire has long since covered up what happened at Chernobog.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: The voices craving resistance are like water. They might be burnt and dry up, but they'll eventually return to the land as rain.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Returning to Ursus is easier said than done. There are too many factors involved, and more things for me to confirm.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: That's your problem. Not ours.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Talulah...

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Even if Reunion can turn a new leaf, representing once again freedom and happiness...

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: What about you, Talulah? Your sins can't be washed away. Your existence is Reunion's darkest history.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: How can you face the pure-white tundra as you are?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I know that I stand here today no longer as a leader, but as a symbol, a flag, or even... a weapon to be wielded.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But I'll take it. I'll accept the shackles you place on me. I've had many different identities—Draco, noble, leader, Infected... None of these matter anymore.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Today I remain only someone who once scattered the seeds of sin.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The wrongs I committed in Ursus, I will repay in Ursus.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Repay... you make it sound so simple.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I will not act as just a flag this time.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Then how?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll throw myself into a true blaze and let it all burn, until even the tundra's chill melts away.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll go back to Ursus... to truly face my own trial.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And you can be there to witness it, Nine.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Witness the end of Reunion, and the birth of something new from its corpse. That's what you truly want, is it not?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You really don't mind?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The Reunion of my heart died long ago on the tundra... along with my companions.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll go with you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Scared I'll harm more innocents?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Both you and Nine.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: After following Reunion for a while, I can confirm that the group has changed somewhat.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: For good or bad... I can't say.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't want to miss your trial, but I also don't want to jump to any hasty conclusions about whether the path Nine insists on is correct.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: From now on, I'll keep an eye on you as Rhodes Island Operator Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I need to keep Rhodes Island informed, no matter what happens in Ursus.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Talulah, Nine... I'm responsible for you both.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: ...Whatever.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Now, you should probably get going. Leave the soldiers to me. I'll catch up after I make sure they're okay.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We didn't say we'd wait for you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Have you ever? I've always had to catch up on my own.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Onwards to Ursus then.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Onwards to Ursus.
The flames continue to spread slowly from the tip of the blade.
Hot flames lick the bodies piled up in a corner, gently enveloping them.
Amid the light crackling of the fire, Talulah silently prays for the flames to bring them to a brighter and warmer place.
